narr: Heavy rain, 1.5 to 3 inches, produced flooding in and around Ypsilanti, Canton, and Northville.
ev: Water over roadway with multiple stranded vehicles near Stamford Rd and MacArthur Blvd. Water over roadway with a vehicle stranded near Washtenaw Ave and Glencoe Hills Drive. Curb to curb street flooding near the intersection of E Spring and S Grove Streets. |6 Mile and Northville Rd impassable due to flood waters; cars getting stuck.
